name: boros aggro

winrate_basis.why: no head-to-head winrate exists for Modern in any source this repo can reach: statistics_matchups returns zero rows for the format, statistics_archetypes carries no winrate field, and this run's own fingerprint records winrate_vs_field as all-zero. Recording a number here would be inventing one.

opponent_gameplan: White and red one-drops into Ajani and Voice of Victory, with Ranger-Captain of Eos protecting the alpha strike and Goblin Bombardment converting a stalled board into reach.

opponent_plan.posture_why: Their one-drop curve beats our goldfish by a turn, and Ranger-Captain of Eos plus Goblin Bombardment convert a stalled board into the last points before we can rebuild.

key_cards.why: a protected threat that also stops us casting spells on their turn, so the alpha strike goes unanswered
sacrificed, it stops our noncreature spells for the turn, which is the cascade turn they are racing to
turns a board we have blocked or swept into reach, so the race does not stall out

primary_gameplan: Buy a turn with Anger, then land Living End into a board they have overcommitted to and stabilise behind Generous Ent and Colossal Skyturtle.
pitfalls: Cascading into a Ranger-Captain of Eos sacrifice, which stops noncreature spells for the turn.
Sweeping on curve when they are holding two cards - the second wave is why we keep Endurance.
Leaving Boseiju in the deck without a plan for Rest in Peace; it is the only maindeck answer we can find on demand.
stance_rationale: Same shape as Boros Energy without the energy payoff: a three-damage exile sweeper on turn three is the card that turns a lost race into a Living End turn.

opposing_sideboard_in.why: a two-for-one on our manabase that also presents a four-power body
exiles our graveyard on entry and keeps it empty, blanking Living End completely
counters the cascaded Living End, Force of Negation and Subtlety, all cast for no mana
shuts off the green and blue halves of an almost entirely nonbasic manabase

play_plan.keep: Double red on three, or a cascade on three with a red source; mulligan hands that cannot interact until four.
play_plan.goldfish_for: Anger after the second Ocelot Pride trigger, then cascade with Endurance still in hand.
play_plan.watch_for: Ranger-Captain of Eos on the board means their sacrifice stops our cascade turn entirely.
play_plan.posture_why: their clock beats our goldfish by a turn.
